overview_description.description:
Screenleap allows you to share your screen and view it from any web-enabled device without installing any software. Our mission is to do for screen sharing what Dropbox did for file sharing: make screen sharing a hassle-free experience that just works across all devices.

We also allow developers to add screen sharing to their applications using our API (http://www.screenleap.com/api). Our screen sharing service has been integrated into a variety of products and services ranging from audio-conferences services to e-learning platforms, sales tools, and support applications.

product.name: Screen Sharing Software
product.description: Allows users to share their computer screen instantly to any device with a web browser without requiring software installation on the viewer's side.

product.name: Video Conferencing
product.description: Provides video communication by sharing the user's camera feed with viewers during meetings or screen sharing sessions.

product.name: Audio Conferencing
product.description: Enables two-way audio communication during meetings using the computer's microphone and speakers without software installation.

product.name: Website Integration
product.description: Allows websites to embed live screen sharing, video, and audio conferencing features quickly without coding.

product.name: Screen Control Sharing
product.description: Permits viewers to share control of the presenter's computer screen remotely without installing software.

product.name: Cloud Recording
product.description: Enables recording of meetings and screen sharing sessions with automatic cloud storage and sharing capabilities.
